product_framing.identity: Handshake is both a model-agnostic IDE/harness and a linked creative-production environment.
product_framing.managed_project_graph: SurrealDB-canonical root projects may contain subprojects, tasks, prototypes, taskboards, work packets, microtasks and execution workspaces.
product_framing.hierarchy_boundary: Managed-project hierarchy is not the product-module hierarchy.
product_framing.loom_role: Loom supplies typed, provenance-preserving connectivity across Notes/backlinks, source code, datasets, media, CKC assets and future Tailor/Studio publishers.
product_framing.future_module_boundary: CKC is the product-navigation parent for future Tailor. Tailor retains its domain/solver authority; Studio remains separately authoritative. WP017 adds generic seams and fixtures only.

storage_authority.canonical: SurrealDB is the sole main database authority for all Handshake-managed projects.
storage_authority.locus: Locus owns canonical managed-project, work-packet, microtask, dependency, assignment, receipt and recovery semantics on SurrealDB.
storage_authority.loom: Loom owns canonical connectivity/index projection semantics on SurrealDB without copying source-module authority.
storage_authority.turso: Conditional non-authoritative per-project-and-WP working-store evaluation only. MT-401 rejection short-circuits MT-402..408 to validator-checked NOT_APPLICABLE, MT-409 emits a no-code structured rejection projection and MT-410 closes with REJECT from no-change proof. Only APPROVED_FOR_EVALUATION enables the implementation/UI chain and comparative verdict; neither branch authorizes automatic rollout.

known_blockers_and_gates: OPERATOR-HOLD: WP017 remains unactivated and non-executable.
UPSTREAM: WP-KERNEL-012, WP-1 multi-model orchestration and WP-CKC must each reach validated terminal state and merge into stable main.
STABLE-MAIN-PIN: record the exact post-merge commit as the sole product-code grounding source before refreshing WP017.
POST-MERGE-AUDIT: inspect current Locus, Loom, Notes, CKC, taskboard, work-packet, microtask, project/workspace and SurrealDB source truth; do not reuse historical database assumptions.
SPEC-ENRICHMENT: update the Master Spec from the post-merge audit before finalizing the expanded WP017 contract.
RESEARCH-REFRESH: record current official SurrealDB and Turso capability, concurrency, encryption, portability and failure-mode evidence plus comparable field implementations before implementation.
HBR-REFRESH: recompute all current privacy, diagnostics, manual, quiet-operation, Windows and proof obligations against post-merge authority.

TURSO-EXCEPTION-GATE: no Turso dependency or implementation unless MT-401 records an explicit narrow non-authority evaluation exception; rejection marks MT-402..408 NOT_APPLICABLE, uses MT-409 only for a no-code rejection projection, independently proves the SurrealDB-only baseline intact and closes MT-410 with REJECT.
SIGNATURE: obtain a new operator signature after the expanded post-merge contract is finalized.
ACTIVATION-SURFACES: promote the official packet, synchronize Task Board, Build Order and traceability, create the implementation worktree, then launch through the canonical activation workflow.
naming_note: Dexterity remains the operator-facing name of the model-lane kernel. Project, subproject, task/prototype and workspace identities must remain distinct.
vendor_agnostic_engine_note: Handshake remains model/vendor agnostic; transport-specific adapters do not own product semantics.
